## Implementation Summary for Rule R3

   - **must-pass**: Reply using "开发者大大" consistently (correctly passes)

3. **Hook Configuration**: `/opt/enforce/settings.json`
   - Automatically updated with all three rules (R1, R2, R3) at `Stop` event

✅ All three rules now work together seamlessly

All three rules are now active and enforced!
